title: What Moves the Silver Spot Price (And Why It Swings More Than Gold)
description: Silver's annual volatility averages 30 percent, roughly twice gold's. Here is what drives those swings: futures markets, the gold-silver ratio, ETF flows, and industrial demand floors.
alt: Three stat cards showing silver's 2x volatility vs gold, gold-silver ratio peaked at 124 to 1 in 2020, and 58% industrial demand floor
